name: speech_torch
label: Speech on PyTorch: cloned voices that keep one voice across languages (Qwen3-TTS: zh, en, ja, ko, de, fr, ru, pt, es, it)

adapters.speech_torch.runtime.env.QWEN3_.hint: The model folder under audio models/qwen3-tts: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-Base (about 2.5 GB, faster) or Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base (better, slower). Only Base models clone.

adapters.speech_torch.runtime.env.TTS_DE.hint: auto: the GPU when PyTorch sees one, else the processor (3 to 5 times slower than real time there). cpu forces the processor.

adapters.speech_torch.runtime.env.TTS_DT.hint: auto: bfloat16 on a GPU, float32 on the processor. float16 or float32 if bfloat16 misbehaves on a GPU.

torch_index.hint: PyTorch's wheel index for ROCm; these wheels bring their own runtime

model.hint: Fetched once at install from Hugging Face (huggingface.co is contacted then, never at run time). none: put the model folder under audio models/qwen3-tts yourself

install._doc: qwen-tts's own requirements without gradio (its demo page only)

run: import os; os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY'] = '1'; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('Qwen/{opt:model}', local_dir='{loc:audio_models}/qwen3-tts/{opt:model}')

model.hint: Fetched once at install from Hugging Face. On the processor expect 3 to 5 times slower than real time: for prepared speech, not conversation

run: import os; os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY'] = '1'; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('Qwen/{opt:model}', local_dir='{loc:audio_models}/qwen3-tts/{opt:model}')

defaults._doc: One worker in this module's own environment (its transformers version differs from the image module's). Voices are the clone folders in the audio models location (clones/<name>/ref.wav + ref.txt, the same folders the CPU speech module's F5 engine reads), offered as qwen3:<name>. voice_clone_add makes a new folder from a recording; a name that exists is refused.
